original_prompt: Write a CloudFormation template provisioning an ECS Fargate cluster running two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Write a CloudFormation template provisioning an ECS Fargate cluster running two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: ECS Fargate cluster running two microservices behind an internal NLB (production-ready, secure defaults)

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging and naming.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet.
  ServiceAImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/amazonlinux/amazonlinux:latest
    Description: Container image URI for Service A.
  ServiceBImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/amazonlinux/amazonlinux:latest
    Description: Container image URI for Service B.
  ServiceACPU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
    Description: CPU units for Service A task (Fargate).
  ServiceAMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues: [512, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096, 5120, 6144, 7168, 8192, 16384, 30720]
    Description: Memory (MiB) for Service A task (Fargate).
  ServiceBCPU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
    Description: CPU units for Service B task (Fargate).
  ServiceBMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues: [512, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096, 5120, 6144, 7168, 8192, 16384, 30720]
    Description: Memory (MiB) for Service B task (Fargate).
  DesiredCountA:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Desired task count for Service A.
  DesiredCountB:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Desired task count for Service B.
  ListenerPortA:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: NLB listener port for Service A.
  ListenerPortB:
    Type: Number
    Default: 81
    Description: NLB listener port for Service B.
  ContainerPortA:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
    Description: Container port exposed by Service A.
  ContainerPortB:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
    Description: Container port exposed by Service B.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1,3,5,7,14,30,60,90,120,150,180,365,400,545,731,1827,3653]
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention in days.

Mappings:
  RegionMap:
    # Placeholder for regions if needed in future (kept for extensibility)

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-az1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-az2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rtb-az1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rtb-az2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS access to VPC endpoints from ECS tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ECSServiceSecurityGroup
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 0
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg

  ECSServiceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks behind internal NLB
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPortA
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPortA
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPortB
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPortB
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 0
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-svc-sg

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EcsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EcsAgentEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecs-agent
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EcsTelemetryEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecs-telemetry
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  SSMAEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster
      CapacityProviders:
        - FARGATE
        - FARGATE_SPOT
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecsTaskExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdditionalExecutionPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-execution-role

  ECSTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecsTaskRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-task-role

  ServiceALogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-a
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ServiceBLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-b
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ServiceATaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a
      Cpu: !Ref ServiceACPU
      Memory: !Ref ServiceAMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
      RuntimePlatform:
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-a
          Image: !Ref ServiceAImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPortA
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceALogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service-a
          Environment:
            - Name: SERVICE_NAME
              Value: service-a
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a-td

  ServiceBTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b
      Cpu: !Ref ServiceBCPU
      Memory: !Ref ServiceBMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
      RuntimePlatform:
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-b
          Image: !Ref ServiceBImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPortB
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceBLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service-b
          Environment:
            - Name: SERVICE_NAME
              Value: service-b
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b-td

  InternalNLB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-internal-nlb
      Type: network
      Scheme: internal
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled
          Value: 'true'
        - Key: deletion_protection.enabled
          Value: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-internal-nlb

  ServiceATargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-a-tg
      TargetType: ip
      Port: !Ref ContainerPortA
      Protocol: TCP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 10
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-a-tg

  ServiceBTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-b-tg
      TargetType: ip
      Port: !Ref ContainerPortB
      Protocol: TCP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 10
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-b-tg

  ListenerA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref InternalNLB
      Port: !Ref ListenerPortA
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref ServiceATargetGroup

  ListenerB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref InternalNLB
      Port: !Ref ListenerPortB
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref ServiceBTargetGroup

  ECSServiceA:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - ListenerA
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCountA
      EnableExecuteCommand: true
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ECSServiceSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref ServiceATargetGroup
          ContainerName: service-a
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPortA
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a

  ECSServiceB:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - ListenerB
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCountB
      EnableExecuteCommand: true
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ECSServiceSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref ServiceBTargetGroup
          ContainerName: service-b
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPortB
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  ClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster name
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ECSServiceAName:
    Description: ECS Service A name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSServiceA.Name
  ECSServiceBName:
    Description: ECS Service B name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSServiceB.Name
  InternalNLBDNSName:
    Description: Internal NLB DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt InternalNLB.DNSName
  ServiceATargetGroupArn:
    Description: Target group ARN for Service A
    Value: !Ref ServiceATargetGroup
  ServiceBTargetGroupArn:
    Description: Target group ARN for Service B
    Value: !Ref ServiceBTargetGroup

      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:

      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr

  SSMAEndpoint:

      VpcId: !Ref VPC

      SubnetIds:

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:

    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster
      CapacityProviders:
        - FARGATE
        - FARGATE_SPOT
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecsTaskExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:

      Policies:

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-execution-role

  ECSTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecsTaskRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-task-role

  ServiceALogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-a
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ServiceBLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-b
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ServiceATaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a
      Cpu: !Ref ServiceACPU
      Memory: !Ref ServiceAMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
      RuntimePlatform:
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-a
          Image: !Ref ServiceAImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPortA
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceALogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service-a
          Environment:
            - Name: SERVICE_NAME
              Value: service-a
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a-td

  ServiceBTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b
      Cpu: !Ref ServiceBCPU
      Memory: !Ref ServiceBMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
      RuntimePlatform:
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-b
          Image: !Ref ServiceBImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPortB
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceBLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service-b
          Environment:
            - Name: SERVICE_NAME
              Value: service-b
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b-td

  InternalNLB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-internal-nlb
      Type: network
      Scheme: internal
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled
          Value: 'true'
        - Key: deletion_protection.enabled
          Value: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-internal-nlb

  ServiceATargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-a-tg
      TargetType: ip
      Port: !Ref ContainerPortA
      Protocol: TCP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 10
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-a-tg

  ServiceBTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-b-tg
      TargetType: ip
      Port: !Ref ContainerPortB
      Protocol: TCP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 10
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-b-tg

  ListenerA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref InternalNLB
      Port: !Ref ListenerPortA
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref ServiceATargetGroup

  ListenerB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref InternalNLB
      Port: !Ref ListenerPortB
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref ServiceBTargetGroup

  ECSServiceA:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - ListenerA
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCountA
      EnableExecuteCommand: true
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ECSServiceSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref ServiceATargetGroup
          ContainerName: service-a
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPortA
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a

  ECSServiceB:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - ListenerB
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCountB
      EnableExecuteCommand: true
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ECSServiceSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref ServiceBTargetGroup
          ContainerName: service-b
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPortB
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  ClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster name
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ECSServiceAName:
    Description: ECS Service A name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSServiceA.Name
  ECSServiceBName:
    Description: ECS Service B name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSServiceB.Name
  InternalNLBDNSName:
    Description: Internal NLB DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt InternalNLB.DNSName
  ServiceATargetGroupArn:
    Description: Target group ARN for Service A
    Value: !Ref ServiceATargetGroup
  ServiceBTargetGroupArn:
    Description: Target group ARN for Service B
    Value: !Ref ServiceBTargetGroup

message.content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: ECS Fargate cluster running two microservices behind an internal NLB (production-ready, secure defaults)

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging and naming.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet.
  ServiceAImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/amazonlinux/amazonlinux:latest
    Description: Container image URI for Service A.
  ServiceBImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/amazonlinux/amazonlinux:latest
    Description: Container image URI for Service B.
  ServiceACPU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
    Description: CPU units for Service A task (Fargate).
  ServiceAMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues: [512, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096, 5120, 6144, 7168, 8192, 16384, 30720]
    Description: Memory (MiB) for Service A task (Fargate).
  ServiceBCPU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
    Description: CPU units for Service B task (Fargate).
  ServiceBMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues: [512, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096, 5120, 6144, 7168, 8192, 16384, 30720]
    Description: Memory (MiB) for Service B task (Fargate).
  DesiredCountA:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Desired task count for Service A.
  DesiredCountB:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Desired task count for Service B.
  ListenerPortA:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: NLB listener port for Service A.
  ListenerPortB:
    Type: Number
    Default: 81
    Description: NLB listener port for Service B.
  ContainerPortA:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
    Description: Container port exposed by Service A.
  ContainerPortB:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
    Description: Container port exposed by Service B.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1,3,5,7,14,30,60,90,120,150,180,365,400,545,731,1827,3653]
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention in days.

Mappings:
  RegionMap:
    # Placeholder for regions if needed in future (kept for extensibility)

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-az1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-az2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rtb-az1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rtb-az2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS access to VPC endpoints from ECS tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ECSServiceSecurityGroup
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 0
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg

  ECSServiceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks behind internal NLB
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPortA
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPortA
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPortB
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPortB
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 0
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-svc-sg

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EcrDkrEndpoint:

    Properties:

      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EcsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EcsAgentEndpoint:

    Properties:

      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EcsTelemetryEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  SSMAEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup]
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster
      CapacityProviders:
        - FARGATE
        - FARGATE_SPOT
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecsTaskExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdditionalExecutionPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage

                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-execution-role

  ECSTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecsTaskRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action:

      Policies: []

        - Key: Name

  ServiceALogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-a

  ServiceBLogGroup:

    Properties:

  ServiceATaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:

      Cpu: !Ref ServiceACPU
      Memory: !Ref ServiceAMemory

      RequiresCompatibilities:

      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn

      RuntimePlatform:

        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-a
          Image: !Ref ServiceAImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPortA

          LogConfiguration:

            Options:

              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service-a
          Environment:
            - Name: SERVICE_NAME
              Value: service-a
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a-td

  ServiceBTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b
      Cpu: !Ref ServiceBCPU
      Memory: !Ref ServiceBMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:

      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
      RuntimePlatform:
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-b
          Image: !Ref ServiceBImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPortB
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceBLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service-b
          Environment:
            - Name: SERVICE_NAME
              Value: service-b
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b-td

  InternalNLB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-internal-nlb
      Type: network
      Scheme: internal
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled
          Value: 'true'
        - Key: deletion_protection.enabled
          Value: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-internal-nlb

  ServiceATargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-a-tg
      TargetType: ip
      Port: !Ref ContainerPortA
      Protocol: TCP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 10
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-a-tg

  ServiceBTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-b-tg
      TargetType: ip
      Port: !Ref ContainerPortB
      Protocol: TCP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 10
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-b-tg

  ListenerA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref InternalNLB
      Port: !Ref ListenerPortA
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref ServiceATargetGroup

  ListenerB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref InternalNLB
      Port: !Ref ListenerPortB
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref ServiceBTargetGroup

  ECSServiceA:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - ListenerA
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCountA
      EnableExecuteCommand: true
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ECSServiceSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref ServiceATargetGroup
          ContainerName: service-a
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPortA
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a

  ECSServiceB:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - ListenerB
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCountB
      EnableExecuteCommand: true
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ECSServiceSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref ServiceBTargetGroup
          ContainerName: service-b
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPortB
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  ClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster name
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ECSServiceAName:
    Description: ECS Service A name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSServiceA.Name
  ECSServiceBName:
    Description: ECS Service B name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSServiceB.Name
  InternalNLBDNSName:
    Description: Internal NLB DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt InternalNLB.DNSName
  ServiceATargetGroupArn:
    Description: Target group ARN for Service A
    Value: !Ref ServiceATargetGroup
  ServiceBTargetGroupArn:
    Description: Target group ARN for Service B
    Value: !Ref ServiceBTargetGroup
